text: {character:Mary Saotome}Yawn!
Mary Saotome
With the rising sun, the high school girls who fought all night are on their way back.
{character:Mary Saotome}We were duped. If we just let any one of us win, everyone else can just follow the winner out of here, right?

{character:Mary Saotome}Can't believe we didn't think of this and played mahjong all night long like idiots. So stupid! I have things to do today. And now I have to go there with these dark circles under my eyes...
{character:Mary Saotome}...Well, that's true. If I lose, who knows how you guys will make fun of me?
{character:Mary Saotome}(I won't call that a victory though. It was too close.)
Yumeko Jabami
{character:Yumeko Jabami}I really want to play for another night like this. Speaking of which, we don't need to worry about our research topic anymore.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}It'll be fine. The president seemed to have fun, too.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}Speaking of which, where is the president? She said she wanted to walk around, but now she's nowhere to be seen.
{character:Mary Saotome}I need to catch up on some sleep when we're back. Can you cover for me this afternoon, Yumeko?
{character:Yumeko Jabami}By the way, Mr. Wanjirou said that only people with wishes can visit this shrine.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}We can leave now. Does that mean our wishes are already fulfilled?
{character:Mary Saotome}Huh? You believe in that silly dog's nonsense? There's no such thing.
{character:Mary Saotome}More importantly, I'm starving... Let's go have breakfast somewhere before we head back...
{stop:1000}"The wishes."
"The wish for another battle."
"The wish to follow her true nature."
"The wish to stop feeling adrift."
"They've all been fulfilled, at least kinda, hehe..."
{character:Mary's voice}... Did we forget about someone?
{character:Yumeko's voice}Did we?
{character:Wanjirou}Nikaidou... How long is this girl going to stay, woof?
{character:Miki Nikaidou}You'll be condemned by the gods if you interrupt others' sweet dreams, Wanjirou.
{character:Midari Ikishima}Hehe... So hot... I'm coming...
{character:Midari Ikishima}... Yumeko... Yumeko. Yumeko! Only you can satisfy me. You... You are indeed the best woman!
Yumeko's voice
Wanjirou
Miki Nikaidou
Midari Ikishima
{character:Yumeko Jabami}But even so, the Mary I know is not the kind of person who would treat victory so lightly.
Mary's voice
{character:Mary Saotome}Who cares? She doesn't need to worry about the research topic, anyway. If she wants to walk around, just let her.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}But he's the Dog God.
"The wish for joy."

{character:Mary Saotome}Dog monster or Dog God, I don't think wishes can be granted just by playing a few games of mahjong. Nothing in life is free. After all, it's our work that makes the wishes come true.
{character:Yumeko Jabami}You've got some nerve, Mary. If the president knows you're absent from school activities, it won't end well for you.
{character:Mary Saotome}Ah, you're right. That messy game we played is more than enough for the 'interesting gamble' topic.
{character:Mary Saotome}If the president says it's not a good enough answer, I won't buy it. Because that means she doesn't consider us to be acceptable opponents, right?
